If you’re ready to embark on this week, that means that you have an account with Travis CI, a newly created remote repository for this course and SSH configured on your local development machine with ties to your GitHub profile.

 

This week we’ll be taking a deep dive into the day-to-day operations of a DevOps engineer and what exactly a week may look like. DevOps is not just tooling, automation and bleeding edge tech. There is a great deal of protocols and procedures involved to ensure stability, high-levels of productivity and the ability to introduce damage control for the mitigation of any failures.

 

After looking at some of the operations an engineer is expected to oversee in a work environment, we’ll pick things up where we left off in last week's lab with our Travis CI YML file and perform an analysis on the application we’re responsible for automating CI/CD builds for a Production environment.

 

There will also be a few BASH exercises to be completed to ensure that your CLI skills are maturing well.

A Travis CI account
